before.en: Install ZCode Desktop and sign in with a Start Plan account. If ZCode is not in the default location (/Applications/ZCode.app on macOS, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ZCode on Windows, /opt/ZCode on Linux), set its path in the connection settings.
before.zh-CN: 请安装 ZCode Desktop 并登录 Start Plan 账号。ZCode 不在默认安装位置（macOS 为 /Applications/ZCode.app，Windows 为 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ZCode，Linux 为 /opt/ZCode）时，可在连接设置中填写其路径。

after.en: Check again after signing in. The ZCode Desktop window does not need to stay open.
after.zh-CN: 登录后重新检测；使用时不需要保持 ZCode 窗口打开。
